entities.summary: Raymond Jon Tester is an American farmer and retired politician who served from 2007 to 2025 as a United States senator from Montana. A member of the Democratic Party, Tester served in the Montana Senate from 1999 to 2007, and as its president from 2005 to 2007. As of May 2025, he is a political analyst for MSNOW, and the most recent Democrat to have won or held statewide office in Montana.
